title: Forja model manifest
description: One model: what it is, the adapter that runs it, what it needs, where its pinned weights come from and what its license allows. Manifests are YAML; this schema reads them as JSON.

id.description: Unique across every catalog; used in config, the CLI and the cache key.

description.description: One line for the Models screen.

family.description: Selects the worker and its virtual environment: engine/families/<family>, a model package's family.yaml, or the engine's own (builtin, stub).

adapter.description: module:Class of the forja_sdk.Adapter subclass that runs the model.

adapter_version.description: Mirrors the adapter class's version; part of the stage cache key. Bump both when outputs change for the same inputs.

tasks.description: The stage types the model serves.

license.description: Every manifest carries license metadata; the catalog check rejects one without it.

spdx.description: An SPDX identifier, or LicenseRef-<name> for a license SPDX does not list.

restrictions.description: Plain-language limits the Models screen shows: territories, user counts, attribution.

url.description: The license text at a pinned revision.

requirements.description: Per backend: whether the model runs there and what it needs.

params.description: Stage parameters the model reads, with defaults; the app builds its form from them.

vram_gb.description: Peak VRAM at default params, from the publisher; the engine replaces it with measured peaks.

disk_gb.description: Disk an install takes: environment plus weights.

rank.description: Orders models for the same stage when a preset leaves the model open; higher first.

stub.description: A deterministic stand-in for tests, picked only with models.stubs = true.

views.description: The views of the subject the model reads besides the front.

python.description: An explicit interpreter, for development only; catalog manifests leave it out.

weights.description: Where install downloads the weights from. Pinned: a commit revision, and sha256 for listed files.

revision.description: A full commit sha, never a branch or tag.
